title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: custom engine agents for GCC High users
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing statements and documented block controls are supported, and it clearly distinguishes general documentation from unconfirmed GCC High details. One minor correction should acknowledge that another Learn page documents proactive messaging despite the known-issues page listing proactive notifications as unsupported.
